verdict.rationale: Sunbiz is Florida's official state business-entity registry and filing service. Its authority comes from being the state-operated system of record, so self-hosting the core product is a category error for this kind of product, and nothing in the evidence suggests it ships a self-hostable distribution. The robots.txt probe concerns crawler access to the filing host and is not relevant to self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
